description: This PHP class defines a service layer for managing job titles within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It provides methods for retrieving, saving, and deleting job titles and related attachments, acting as an intermediary between controllers and data access objects (DAOs).

classes.name: JobTitleService
classes.description: Service class providing methods for managing job titles and related entities within the HRM system.

methods.name: getJobTitleDao
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the JobTitleDao instance.

methods.name: getJobTitleList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of job titles, optionally filtering only active ones.

methods.name: deleteJobTitle
methods.description: Flags specified job titles as deleted.

methods.name: getJobTitleById
methods.description: Retrieves a job title by its unique identifier.

methods.name: getJobSpecAttachmentById
methods.description: Retrieves a job specification attachment by its ID.

methods.name: saveJobTitle
methods.description: Persists a JobTitle entity to the database.

methods.name: getJobTitleArray
methods.description: Returns an array of normalized job title models.

methods.name: getJobTitleArrayForEmployee
methods.description: Returns normalized job titles for a specific employee.
